scope: EURUSD Q1 2022, canonical M15 replay, diagnostic only
findings: The full stack preserves D1/H4/H1/M15 at sweep time and projects it with the signal.
D1/H1 filtered 10 H4-only signals before they entered the lower-timeframe sequence; this is a context veto, not a timeout or loss of memory.
Direction-flip invalidations fell from 24 to 1, indicating that the sequence is less exposed to lower-timeframe bias replacement.
Trade outcomes are not edge evidence: the horizon leaves most outcomes OPEN and the sample is small.

performance.finding: Full context is materially more expensive than H4-only; cache snapshots while the last closed D1/H4/H1 bars do not change.
performance.decision: Do not infer an operational edge or promote this diagnostic result.
